title: Collateral, Lien and Ownership Terms of the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage
content:
The Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage is secured by the borrower's principal residence. The lien each plan takes, the kinds of property and title it accepts, and how many Summit loans a borrower may hold are set plan by plan as follows.

| Plan | Lien position | Existing forward first mortgage may stay ahead | Condominium without FHA approval eligible | Title in a revocable living trust | May also hold a HECM | Open Summit loans per borrower, at most |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | first | no | no | yes | no | 1 |
| Summit Flex Fixed | first | no | no | yes | no | 1 |
| Summit Select Line | first | no | no | yes | no | 1 |
| Summit Condo Line | first | no | yes | yes | no | 1 |
| Summit Second Lien | second | yes | no | yes | no | 1 |
| Summit Estate Line | first | no | no | yes | no | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Lien.** Five plans take a first lien. The Summit Second Lien takes a second lien and is the only Summit plan under which an existing forward first mortgage may remain ahead of the Summit loan.
- **Condominiums.** A condominium that does not carry FHA approval is eligible only under the Summit Condo Line; under every other plan it is not.
- **Trusts.** Under every plan, title may be held in a revocable living trust.
- **HECM.** No Summit plan may be held by a borrower together with a HECM.
- **Number of loans.** Under every plan a borrower may hold at most 1 open Summit loan.

## Illustrative questions (hypothetical properties)

| Hypothetical property | Plan considered | Outcome under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Condominium without FHA approval | Summit Condo Line | eligible |
| Condominium without FHA approval | Summit Estate Line | not eligible |
| Home with a forward first mortgage the owner keeps | Summit Second Lien | the first mortgage may stay ahead |
| Home with a forward first mortgage the owner keeps | Summit Flex Fixed | the first mortgage may not stay ahead |
| Home titled in a revocable living trust | any Summit plan | title in the trust is accepted |
